description_for_human: Create and review spaced-repetition flashcards using the Leitner box system.
description_for_model: You are interacting with the streamboard API, a spaced-repetition flashcard system using the Leitner box system. Users organize flashcards into decks. Each card has a front (question) and back (answer). Cards progress through boxes 1-5 based on review results: passing moves a card to a higher box with longer review intervals, failing moves it back to box 1. Use the review endpoints to fetch due cards and submit pass/fail results. When creating cards, keep fronts as clear questions and backs as concise answers.
